tei:titleStmt.tei:title: Prayer for Someone Who Undergoes Chemotherapy (Gebet für eine Person, die sich einer Chemotherapie unterzieht), by Rabbi Lior Bar-Ami

tei:div.tei:head: Prayer for Someone Who Undergoes Chemotherapy (Gebet für eine Person, die sich einer Chemotherapie unterzieht), by Rabbi Lior Bar-Ami

tei:lg.tei:l: Blessed are You,
Adonai our God,
Ruler of the universe,
Who grants strength and courage in times of difficulty.
As I undergo chemotherapy, I offer this personal blessing:
I stand before You, humbled and in need of Your presence.
As the medications flow through my veins,
I ask for Your healing touch to permeate every part of my being.
Grant me the strength
to face each treatment with resilience and hope.
Help me find inner peace
amidst the uncertainty and fear.
Guide my medical team with wisdom and skill,
that they may administer the treatments with precision and care.
In moments of weakness and discomfort,
may I feel Your comforting embrace.
Grant me patience and endurance
as I navigate the side effects,
knowing that You walk beside me, lending me strength.
Blessed are You,
Adonai our God,
Who bestows healing upon the sick.
I pray for Your mercy and grace
to flow through the medications and treatments,
bringing about the desired outcome.
In this challenging journey,
help me discover the beauty in small victories and the blessings
hidden within the struggle.
Strengthen my faith
and remind me that I am never alone.
With gratitude in my heart,
I thank You for the gift of life
and the opportunity to seek healing.
May this experience deepen my connection to You
and to those around me.
Blessed are You,
Adonai our God,
Who blesses us with resilience and hope.
May this journey through chemotherapy
be a stepping stone toward renewed health,
a testament to the power of faith
and the miracles of Your healing touch.
